turns.question: Can you describe the timeline of this deterioration — when did the seizure occur, how quickly did the agitation and abnormal behaviour develop, and when was the severe anaemia and graft dysfunction first recognised? Also, what immunosuppression regimen is the patient currently on, and has it been changed recently?

assessment.summary: 23-year-old kidney transplant recipient with acute multi-system deterioration: tonic-clonic seizure, delirium/agitation, severe anaemia, and acute allograft dysfunction. The temporal relationship between these findings is not yet established. Differential includes thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA) affecting brain and graft, CNS infection in the setting of immunosuppression, uraemic encephalopathy, and drug toxicity. The co-occurrence of anaemia and graft dysfunction with neurological features raises concern for a unifying process such as TMA, but a single cause has not been confirmed.
